title: Grimoire
description: The agent's executable library: scripts, versions, and every recorded execution.

recent_executions.title: Recent executions
recent_executions.description: The append-only run log, newest first.
recent_executions.sql:
SELECT e.id AS exec, s.name, sv.version, e.exit_code, round(e.duration_ms / 1000.0, 2) AS seconds, e.started_at
FROM execution e
JOIN script_version sv ON sv.id = e.script_version_id
JOIN script s ON s.id = sv.script_id
ORDER BY e.started_at DESC, e.id DESC
LIMIT 100

top_scripts_by_use.title: Top scripts by use
top_scripts_by_use.description: Most-run scripts with their success rate (from the script_health view).
top_scripts_by_use.sql:
SELECT name, runs, round(success_rate, 3) AS success_rate, last_used
FROM script_health
WHERE runs > 0
ORDER BY runs DESC, last_used DESC
LIMIT 50

failure_feed.title: Failure feed
failure_feed.description: Non-zero-exit executions, newest first — the triage queue.
failure_feed.sql:
SELECT e.id AS exec, s.name, sv.version, e.exit_code, e.started_at
FROM execution e
JOIN script_version sv ON sv.id = e.script_version_id
JOIN script s ON s.id = sv.script_id
WHERE e.exit_code != 0
ORDER BY e.started_at DESC, e.id DESC
LIMIT 100

script_affinity.title: Script affinity (ran adjacently)
script_affinity.description: Pairs where one script ran immediately after another in a session — emergent pipelines, from the script_affinity view.
script_affinity.sql:
SELECT sa.name AS ran_first, sb.name AS then_ran, aff.times_adjacent
FROM script_affinity aff
JOIN script sa ON sa.id = aff.a
JOIN script sb ON sb.id = aff.b
WHERE aff.a != aff.b
ORDER BY aff.times_adjacent DESC, ran_first, then_ran
LIMIT 50
